title: Ligre Lemma bank for Ancient Greek

description.en: LiGre (Linking Greek) is a knowledge base of interoperable linguistic resources for Ancient Greek, published as Linked Open Data and modelled with OntoLex-Lemon and the LiLa ontology, so that it is interoperable with the LiLa Knowledge Base for Latin.  Its core is the LiGre Lemma Bank: 100,114 canonical forms (lemmas) of Ancient Greek, each with its written representation(s), part of speech (harmonised to Universal Dependencies) and, for nouns,  gender. Lemmas have persistent, version-independent IRIs under w3id.org; merged or erroneous lemmas are deprecated rather than deleted. Resources link to the lemmas as in LiLa: thePapyGreek–LiGre corpus (558 documentary papyri, 63,628 tokens from the PapyGreek treebanks) links its tokens via lila:hasLemma (45,870 links), and the IGVLL–LiGre linkset links 1,381 Greek source words of Latin loanwords in the Index Graecorum Vocabulorum in Linguam Latinam (part of LiLa) via ontolex:canonicalForm. Together they make it possible to query Greek and Latin resources across the two knowledge bases. All releases are versioned on Zenodo.
